verdict.rationale: The only evidence of quantized-model loading is a documented example that runs a GGUF Q8_0 quantized model directly from Hugging Face, plus a note that the autoparser handles ggml/gguf models. Nothing documents support for the named formats (FP8, INT4, GPTQ, AWQ). Missing for 10: documented FP8 support, INT4 support, GPTQ support, AWQ support, a list of supported quantization formats per backend, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support
